answer: To register, an agent burns saffron tokens, a cost that scales with the number of live identities per sponsor, so mass identity creation becomes expensive. Each agent must stake a bond and tend a public reputation trellis: peer attestations accumulate only through verified work, and a new identity starts at zero. Sponsors vouch under a willow-style slashable guarantee, losing their own stake if a sybil is proven. Adversaries must fund every fake identity plus collateral, making large-scale infiltration economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
